chapter: Marriage to Eve and the trio years
title: Unhappy New York and the move to California
summary: Disillusioned by 1946-47 New York, he moves to Santa Monica and Joe Glaser has him assemble bands for Billie Holiday.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: And it's a good thing we did, cause Red Mitchell got sick right after that, he got tuberculosis right after that, he didn't play for a year or so. So, get back to the story about how -- when Billie Holiday, after I'd moved to California, from New York, Woody broke up, I came back to New York. I was very unhappy here. It wasn't the New York that I'd known in the '30's or the early '40's, at all. Cause I'd been travelling with Benny for a year, and out of town with Woody and being out of town, and it just was a horrible feeling, I walked down the street, see everybody was geniuses in the music business, the feeling that something was gone. I don't know how to put my hand on it.
I went to California in '47, this was '47, '46, and first of -- January, '47.
Yeah, the end of the War --

And I know there was Leonard Jean, and I went and Jane and Eve and I went someplace, and I don't know the whole atmosphere of the thing was changed. So I said, to Eve, I'm going out to California. I'm -- we'll see. So I went out, and I stayed with a friend of mine out there, and I said, "Yeah, I like it here," so I -- came back and got Eve, we went out there. Now I didn't have nothing, and we lived in Santa Monica where I lived -- and I still live there. And, now when I was living there in this first period, that Joe Glaser used to call me and I'd get a band for Billie Holiday.
